title: Quickly Fermented Thai Mozzarella Larb
description: A twist on the classic Thai larb dish featuring fermented mozzarella cheese. Quick to prepare and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: Mozzarella Cheese
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's a block that can be crumbled.

ingredients.name: Minced Galangal
ingredients.notes: Use a microplane to grate if you don't have a galangal chopper.

instructions: In a small bowl, combine 1 tsp fermentation salt and 1 tsp palm sugar. Let it sit at room temperature for 10 minutes to create a starter.
Add the starter to 1 block crumbled mozzarella cheese. Mix until the cheese begins to break down and form a sticky mass.
Transfer the mass to a blender or food processor and blend until it forms a slightly aerated texture.
Transfer the mass to a dehydrator and dehydrate at 135°F (57°C) for 2 hours. This step is crucial in creating the fermented flavor.
After 2 hours, remove the mozzarella from the dehydrator and let it cool to room temperature.
In a separate bowl, mix together chopped cilantro, minced galangal, fish sauce, lime juice, chili flakes, and rice vinegar.
Add the herb mixture to the cooled mozzarella and mix until well combined.
Transfer the larb to a serving dish and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
